77eff880829027daf23b755e14820a60c4c6fd93.name: General
77eff880829027daf23b755e14820a60c4c6fd93.description: A General leads his empire in glorious battles. Their speciality is conquest: faster combat ships and Recyclers, a lower deuterium consumption on Recyclers as well as the spectacular Hamill Manoeuvre give them clear advantages in open confrontation. Only the shipyards of a General may build the pride of their fleet, the Reaper.
77eff880829027daf23b755e14820a60c4c6fd93.effect: Faster Combat Ships, Rapid Recyclers, Economical Ships, Expanded Cargo Bays, Hamill Manoeuvre, Wreckage at attack, More Combat Research Levels, Additional Fleet Slots, Additional Moon Fields, Five-percent increments for fleet speed, Discount on Acceleration (shipyard)

2dd05cc4c0e185fce2e712112dc44932027aee98.name: Discoverer
2dd05cc4c0e185fce2e712112dc44932027aee98.description: A Discoverer is fascinated by delves into unknown regions. Their research completes faster and their expeditions are more frequently successful. The planets they settle on offer more space. On expeditions, their fleets can discover lost debris fields that can only be mined with Pathfinders, an exploration ship developed by the Discoverer.
2dd05cc4c0e185fce2e712112dc44932027aee98.effect: Research Bonus, Expedition Bonus, Planet Size, Expedition Debris Fields, More Expeditions, Fewer Expedition Enemies, Increased Phalanx Range, Increased Inactive Plunder, Discount on Acceleration (research)

9374c79a24b84c4331f0d26526ef6c2d33319a6e.name: Collector
9374c79a24b84c4331f0d26526ef6c2d33319a6e.description: A Collector concentrates on production and trade. Their strengths lie in increased mine production, their transports are faster and they have access to larger cargo bays. This allows them to dispatch their goods even more efficiently through space. Only a Collector can build the giant Crawler, which supports his facilities in resource mining.
9374c79a24b84c4331f0d26526ef6c2d33319a6e.effect: Increased Production, Increased Energy Production, Rapid Transporters, Expanded Cargo Bays, Increased Crawler Bonus, Increased Maximum Number of Crawlers, Overload Crawler, Discount on Acceleration (buildings)

1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.name: Researchers (Alliance)
1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.description: The biggest discoveries are made when many great minds work together. An alliance of Researchers not only discovers larger planets to colonise, but their ships are also faster on expeditions. Together they have access to the system phalanx, which can be used to scan fleet movements in entire systems.
1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.effect:
+10% speed to expedition destination
+5% larger planets on colonisation
Access to system phalanx: for 40,000 deuterium this can be used to scan fleet movements in whole systems, as long as these are within range.

6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.name: Traders (Alliance)
6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.description: Trade alliances are rewarding for all parties involved, and no-one knows this better than an alliance of Traders. Their transporters fly faster and the processes of energy and resource production have been optimised, so they can make big bucks. With their improved logistics they also have more storage on their planets and moons.
6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.effect:
+10% speed for transporters
+5% production on resources and energy
+10% storage capacity on moons and planets

9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.name: Warriors (Alliance)
9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.description: Sometimes the most powerful Warriors have to make a pact in order to rule over the galaxy together. The espionage technology available to such a union allows them to identify worthy targets for their conquests more easily. Together, their technology is even stronger and they are ready for anything.
9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.effect:
+10% speed for ships flying between alliance members
+1 combat research levels
+1 espionage research levels
Access to espionage system: sends the selected number of espionage probes out to scan a whole system. You can set the type of celestial body to research, the time since the last espionage attack or desired player activity.

85685be4b82558e9d293cbd9807cf1a701b4186e.name: Researchers (Alliance)
85685be4b82558e9d293cbd9807cf1a701b4186e.description: The biggest discoveries are made when many great minds work together. An alliance of Researchers not only discovers larger planets to colonise, but their ships are also faster on expeditions. Together they have access to the system phalanx, which can be used to scan fleet movements in entire systems.
85685be4b82558e9d293cbd9807cf1a701b4186e.effect:
+10% speed to expedition destination
+5% larger planets on colonisation
Access to system phalanx: for 40,000 deuterium this can be used to scan fleet movements in whole systems, as long as these are within range.

a9a3fdc791a461799d4cee442adf49892da9f702.name: Traders (Alliance)
a9a3fdc791a461799d4cee442adf49892da9f702.description: Trade alliances are rewarding for all parties involved, and no-one knows this better than an alliance of Traders. Their transporters fly faster and the processes of energy and resource production have been optimised, so they can make big bucks. With their improved logistics they also have more storage on their planets and moons.
a9a3fdc791a461799d4cee442adf49892da9f702.effect:
+10% speed for transporters
+5% production on resources and energy
+10% storage capacity on moons and planets

c3d0f35c8138fcfd30a0cf8136b0b7a45df69ecf.name: Warriors (Alliance)
c3d0f35c8138fcfd30a0cf8136b0b7a45df69ecf.description: Sometimes the most powerful Warriors have to make a pact in order to rule over the galaxy together. The espionage technology available to such a union allows them to identify worthy targets for their conquests more easily. Together, their technology is even stronger and they are ready for anything.
c3d0f35c8138fcfd30a0cf8136b0b7a45df69ecf.effect:
+10% speed for ships flying between alliance members
+1 combat research levels
+1 espionage research levels
Access to espionage system: sends the selected number of espionage probes out to scan a whole system. You can set the type of celestial body to research, the time since the last espionage attack or desired player activity.

f98bf0389d2ced4b378838a76f62a9169d5a2874.name: Discoverer
f98bf0389d2ced4b378838a76f62a9169d5a2874.description: A Discoverer is fascinated by delves into unknown regions. Their research completes faster and their expeditions are more frequently successful. The planets they settle on offer more space. On expeditions, their fleets can discover lost debris fields that can only be mined with Pathfinders, an exploration ship developed by the Discoverer.
f98bf0389d2ced4b378838a76f62a9169d5a2874.effect: Research Bonus, Expedition Bonus, Planet Size, Expedition Debris Fields, More Expeditions, Fewer Expedition Enemies, Increased Phalanx Range, Increased Inactive Plunder, Discount on Acceleration (research)

8ec027a1386d21e5fd9454d010fc8531cf046a7d.name: Collector
8ec027a1386d21e5fd9454d010fc8531cf046a7d.description: A Collector concentrates on production and trade. Their strengths lie in increased mine production, their transports are faster and they have access to larger cargo bays. This allows them to dispatch their goods even more efficiently through space. Only a Collector can build the giant Crawler, which supports his facilities in resource mining.
8ec027a1386d21e5fd9454d010fc8531cf046a7d.effect: Increased Production, Increased Energy Production, Rapid Transporters, Expanded Cargo Bays, Increased Crawler Bonus, Increased Maximum Number of Crawlers, Overload Crawler, Discount on Acceleration (buildings)

786c951613fdac965e7ec2919488c62ab5c623c4.name: General
786c951613fdac965e7ec2919488c62ab5c623c4.description: A General leads his empire in glorious battles. Their speciality is conquest: faster combat ships and Recyclers, a lower deuterium consumption on Recyclers as well as the spectacular Hamill Manoeuvre give them clear advantages in open confrontation. Only the shipyards of a General may build the pride of their fleet, the Reaper.
786c951613fdac965e7ec2919488c62ab5c623c4.effect: Faster Combat Ships, Rapid Recyclers, Economical Ships, Expanded Cargo Bays, Hamill Manoeuvre, Wreckage at attack, More Combat Research Levels, Additional Fleet Slots, Additional Moon Fields, Five-percent increments for fleet speed, Discount on Acceleration (shipyard)

1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.name: Researchers (Alliance)
1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.description: The biggest discoveries are made when many great minds work together. An alliance of Researchers not only discovers larger planets to colonise, but their ships are also faster on expeditions. Together they have access to the system phalanx, which can be used to scan fleet movements in entire systems.
1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.effect:
+10% speed to expedition destination
+5% larger planets on colonisation
Access to system phalanx: for 40,000 deuterium this can be used to scan fleet movements in whole systems, as long as these are within range.

6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.name: Traders (Alliance)
6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.description: Trade alliances are rewarding for all parties involved, and no-one knows this better than an alliance of Traders. Their transporters fly faster and the processes of energy and resource production have been optimised, so they can make big bucks. With their improved logistics they also have more storage on their planets and moons.
6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.effect:
+10% speed for transporters
+5% production on resources and energy
+10% storage capacity on moons and planets

9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.name: Warriors (Alliance)
9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.description: Sometimes the most powerful Warriors have to make a pact in order to rule over the galaxy together. The espionage technology available to such a union allows them to identify worthy targets for their conquests more easily. Together, their technology is even stronger and they are ready for anything.
9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.effect:
+10% speed for ships flying between alliance members
+1 combat research levels
+1 espionage research levels
Access to espionage system: sends the selected number of espionage probes out to scan a whole system. You can set the type of celestial body to research, the time since the last espionage attack or desired player activity.

2dd05cc4c0e185fce2e712112dc44932027aee98.name: Discoverer
2dd05cc4c0e185fce2e712112dc44932027aee98.description: A Discoverer is fascinated by delves into unknown regions. Their research completes faster and their expeditions are more frequently successful. The planets they settle on offer more space. On expeditions, their fleets can discover lost debris fields that can only be mined with Pathfinders, an exploration ship developed by the Discoverer.
2dd05cc4c0e185fce2e712112dc44932027aee98.effect: Research Bonus, Expedition Bonus, Planet Size, Expedition Debris Fields, More Expeditions, Fewer Expedition Enemies, Increased Phalanx Range, Increased Inactive Plunder, Discount on Acceleration (research)

9374c79a24b84c4331f0d26526ef6c2d33319a6e.name: Collector
9374c79a24b84c4331f0d26526ef6c2d33319a6e.description: A Collector concentrates on production and trade. Their strengths lie in increased mine production, their transports are faster and they have access to larger cargo bays. This allows them to dispatch their goods even more efficiently through space. Only a Collector can build the giant Crawler, which supports his facilities in resource mining.
9374c79a24b84c4331f0d26526ef6c2d33319a6e.effect: Increased Production, Increased Energy Production, Rapid Transporters, Expanded Cargo Bays, Increased Crawler Bonus, Increased Maximum Number of Crawlers, Overload Crawler, Discount on Acceleration (buildings)

77eff880829027daf23b755e14820a60c4c6fd93.name: General
77eff880829027daf23b755e14820a60c4c6fd93.description: A General leads his empire in glorious battles. Their speciality is conquest: faster combat ships and Recyclers, a lower deuterium consumption on Recyclers as well as the spectacular Hamill Manoeuvre give them clear advantages in open confrontation. Only the shipyards of a General may build the pride of their fleet, the Reaper.
77eff880829027daf23b755e14820a60c4c6fd93.effect: Faster Combat Ships, Rapid Recyclers, Economical Ships, Expanded Cargo Bays, Hamill Manoeuvre, Wreckage at attack, More Combat Research Levels, Additional Fleet Slots, Additional Moon Fields, Five-percent increments for fleet speed, Discount on Acceleration (shipyard)

1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.name: Researchers (Alliance)
1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.description: The biggest discoveries are made when many great minds work together. An alliance of Researchers not only discovers larger planets to colonise, but their ships are also faster on expeditions. Together they have access to the system phalanx, which can be used to scan fleet movements in entire systems.
1aa36213cb676fd5baad5edc2bee4fbe117a778b.effect:
+10% speed to expedition destination
+5% larger planets on colonisation
Access to system phalanx: for 40,000 deuterium this can be used to scan fleet movements in whole systems, as long as these are within range.

6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.name: Traders (Alliance)
6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.description: Trade alliances are rewarding for all parties involved, and no-one knows this better than an alliance of Traders. Their transporters fly faster and the processes of energy and resource production have been optimised, so they can make big bucks. With their improved logistics they also have more storage on their planets and moons.
6c9fe5e35bdad0d4e3382eb6a5aeac6bc8263752.effect:
+10% speed for transporters
+5% production on resources and energy
+10% storage capacity on moons and planets

9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.name: Warriors (Alliance)
9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.description: Sometimes the most powerful Warriors have to make a pact in order to rule over the galaxy together. The espionage technology available to such a union allows them to identify worthy targets for their conquests more easily. Together, their technology is even stronger and they are ready for anything.
9b48e257cbef6c5df0f03a47cead7f9abda3d437.effect:
+10% speed for ships flying between alliance members
+1 combat research levels
+1 espionage research levels
Access to espionage system: sends the selected number of espionage probes out to scan a whole system. You can set the type of celestial body to research, the time since the last espionage attack or desired player activity.

c3d0f35c8138fcfd30a0cf8136b0b7a45df69ecf.name: Warriors (Alliance)
c3d0f35c8138fcfd30a0cf8136b0b7a45df69ecf.description: Sometimes the most powerful Warriors have to make a pact in order to rule over the galaxy together. The espionage technology available to such a union allows them to identify worthy targets for their conquests more easily. Together, their technology is even stronger and they are ready for anything.
c3d0f35c8138fcfd30a0cf8136b0b7a45df69ecf.effect:
+10% speed for ships flying between alliance members
+1 combat research levels
+1 espionage research levels
Access to espionage system: sends the selected number of espionage probes out to scan a whole system. You can set the type of celestial body to research, the time since the last espionage attack or desired player activity.

a9a3fdc791a461799d4cee442adf49892da9f702.name: Traders (Alliance)
a9a3fdc791a461799d4cee442adf49892da9f702.description: Trade alliances are rewarding for all parties involved, and no-one knows this better than an alliance of Traders. Their transporters fly faster and the processes of energy and resource production have been optimised, so they can make big bucks. With their improved logistics they also have more storage on their planets and moons.
a9a3fdc791a461799d4cee442adf49892da9f702.effect:
+10% speed for transporters
+5% production on resources and energy
+10% storage capacity on moons and planets

85685be4b82558e9d293cbd9807cf1a701b4186e.name: Researchers (Alliance)
85685be4b82558e9d293cbd9807cf1a701b4186e.description: The biggest discoveries are made when many great minds work together. An alliance of Researchers not only discovers larger planets to colonise, but their ships are also faster on expeditions. Together they have access to the system phalanx, which can be used to scan fleet movements in entire systems.
85685be4b82558e9d293cbd9807cf1a701b4186e.effect:
+10% speed to expedition destination
+5% larger planets on colonisation
Access to system phalanx: for 40,000 deuterium this can be used to scan fleet movements in whole systems, as long as these are within range.

f98bf0389d2ced4b378838a76f62a9169d5a2874.name: Discoverer
f98bf0389d2ced4b378838a76f62a9169d5a2874.description: A Discoverer is fascinated by delves into unknown regions. Their research completes faster and their expeditions are more frequently successful. The planets they settle on offer more space. On expeditions, their fleets can discover lost debris fields that can only be mined with Pathfinders, an exploration ship developed by the Discoverer.
f98bf0389d2ced4b378838a76f62a9169d5a2874.effect: Research Bonus, Expedition Bonus, Planet Size, Expedition Debris Fields, More Expeditions, Fewer Expedition Enemies, Increased Phalanx Range, Increased Inactive Plunder, Discount on Acceleration (research)

8ec027a1386d21e5fd9454d010fc8531cf046a7d.name: Collector
8ec027a1386d21e5fd9454d010fc8531cf046a7d.description: A Collector concentrates on production and trade. Their strengths lie in increased mine production, their transports are faster and they have access to larger cargo bays. This allows them to dispatch their goods even more efficiently through space. Only a Collector can build the giant Crawler, which supports his facilities in resource mining.
8ec027a1386d21e5fd9454d010fc8531cf046a7d.effect: Increased Production, Increased Energy Production, Rapid Transporters, Expanded Cargo Bays, Increased Crawler Bonus, Increased Maximum Number of Crawlers, Overload Crawler, Discount on Acceleration (buildings)

786c951613fdac965e7ec2919488c62ab5c623c4.name: General
786c951613fdac965e7ec2919488c62ab5c623c4.description: A General leads his empire in glorious battles. Their speciality is conquest: faster combat ships and Recyclers, a lower deuterium consumption on Recyclers as well as the spectacular Hamill Manoeuvre give them clear advantages in open confrontation. Only the shipyards of a General may build the pride of their fleet, the Reaper.
786c951613fdac965e7ec2919488c62ab5c623c4.effect: Faster Combat Ships, Rapid Recyclers, Economical Ships, Expanded Cargo Bays, Hamill Manoeuvre, Wreckage at attack, More Combat Research Levels, Additional Fleet Slots, Additional Moon Fields, Five-percent increments for fleet speed, Discount on Acceleration (shipyard)
